title: Using retryCount: reminder.retryCount + 1 reads a possibly stale value and can lose increments under concurrency; consid
description: Using retryCount: reminder.retryCount + 1 reads a possibly stale value and can lose increments under concurrency; consider an atomic increment via Prisma (increment: 1) to avoid race conditions (also applies to the similar update in the catch block).

adjudication.why: The new retry updates assign the stale fetched retryCount plus one. Overlapping cron invocations can overwrite one another rather than atomically incrementing the retry count.

title: The deletion logic in scheduleSMSReminders.ts incorrectly deletes non-SMS workflow reminders (e.g., Email, WhatsApp) tha
description: The deletion logic in scheduleSMSReminders.ts incorrectly deletes non-SMS workflow reminders (e.g., Email, WhatsApp) that have retryCount > 1. This occurs because the retryCount condition within the OR clause for deletion lacks a method: WorkflowMethods.SMS filter, causing it to apply to all reminder types instead of only SMS reminders, which is the intended scope of this function.

adjudication.why: The new retryCount > 1 OR branch lacks method: SMS, so deleteMany applies it to reminders for every method. The previous method filter scoped the whole delete to SMS.
